scripts.dev: if [ -x .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi
scripts.start: if [ -x .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi
scripts.lint: if [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff check app; else ruff check app; fi
scripts.lint:fix: if [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff check --fix app; else ruff check --fix app; fi
scripts.typecheck: if [ -x .venv/bin/mypy ]; then .venv/bin/mypy app; else mypy app; fi
scripts.format: if [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff format app; else ruff format app; fi
scripts.format:check: if [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff format --check app; else ruff format --check app; fi
